content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a project where I'm connecting an ESP32 and [product_name] from [company_name] via WiFi. The ESP32 is linked to a WLAN 1100 device from Phoenix Contact. With the ESP32, I'm aiming to measure distance using a VL53L0X laser sensor and retrieve the data through MODBUS TCP with the [product_name] PLC. The ESP32 is successfully connected using MODBUS Poll, as shown in the screenshots ([url], [url]). I can see the values updating in Modbus Poll but am unsure how to configure the [product_name] PLC to read these values—specifically, how to set the parameters based on what Modbus Poll displays and what the PLC requires ([url], [url]).
Thread closed as the question was posted twice. The duplicate topic about ESP32 and [product_name] MODBUS is available in the [product_name] Modbus/TCP conference. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to establish MODBUS TCP communication between an ESP32 and a [product_name] PLC, using WiFi. While they can view data with Modbus Poll, they need guidance on configuring the PLC to correctly read and interpret the values from the ESP32.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects instructions on how to set up the [product_name] PLC so it can receive MODBUS TCP data from the ESP32, similar to the way it appears in Modbus Poll.
